title: I wanted to do something simple this weekend...ended up adding a full UFO boss fight.
author: I-want-to-say
selftext: I recorded this 10 minutes after the first implementation. It was a simple "let's fix some bugs and see how it goes". So I used Runway for images, Autosprite for animations and Claude for coding. The effect is really promising. Now back to polishing and will update Steam build later this week! Search for Pluck Em! if you'd like to try. Demo is out.
